skill_name: Design a board game, featuring natural disasters, that can be played by up to 5 players.
workflow: I present to you Disasteroids, a board game for up to 5 players. In Disasteroids, players explore and survive an unpredictable natural disaster-filled world by dominating resources, building weather shelters, and racing for the highest score. The game board consists of a 9x9 grid with special squares representing natural disasters such as floods, earthquakes, and storms.
